subject: general
question: In 2024, the Ministry of Women and Child Development launched the platform ____ to register and monitor complaints of sexual harassment of women at the workplace.
solution:
The correct answer is __**She-Box**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• SHe-Box Portal: In August 2024, the Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi, launched the SHe-Box (Sexual Harassment electronic-Box) Portal. This portal is designed to enable women to register and monitor complaints related to sexual harassment at the workplace. It aims to provide a simple, , and efficient mechanism for addressing such complaints.
 
• Features of the Portal: The SHe-Box Portal allows users to file complaints online, track their status, and seek redressal. It covers both private and government workplaces, ensuring that women have access to support across various sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Sexual Harassment Complaints: The SHe-Box Portal is a significant initiative aimed at addressing the issue of sexual harassment in workplaces, empowering women by providing them with a direct and confidential way to report incidents.
 
• Access for All Women: The portal is open to all women, whether employed in the public or private sector, ensuring comprehensive coverage and accessibility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Workplace Harassment Laws: The portal operates under the legal framework of the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act, ensuring that complaints are handled as per the prescribed procedures.
 
• Monitoring and Accountability: By providing a tracking mechanism, the portal ensures that complaints are addressed in a timely manner, and complainants can monitor the progress of their cases, enhancing transparency and accountability.
